scope: One new bounded background-intercept fit on each of the 80 existing S04B training histories; all saved inhibited fits and gates remain unchanged.
eligibility: Every case in the existing exact 80-case S04B roster, four regimes and 20 fixed seeds per regime; no replacements or exclusions based on outcomes.

history.prehistory: All saved rows with time < phase start are retained as conditioning parents.
history.parent_interval_convention: All rows with time < phase end; an event receives triggering only from parents with strictly smaller time. Equal-time events do not trigger each other.
history.held_out_conditioning: Sequential observed-history score: realized earlier test events enter the history; future or equal-time events do not. No free-running forecast simulation.

variable.bounds_scope: The existing backbone intercept box is a chosen bounded sensitivity, not an unconstrained MLE or a joint nuisance refit.
variable.initial_historical_value: Read from the frozen generator Law; include its training objective in diagnostics and the train non-worsening check.

precomputation.A: (end-start) * exp(d*((start+end)/T0-1)) * sinh(d*(end-start)/T0)/(d*(end-start)/T0), using its continuous limit at zero
precomputation.constraint: Compute these once per phase; reuse normalized parent kernels. Do not construct inhibitory area-time quadrature plans and do not invoke historical fit(), Integrated(), construct(), generator.run(), or m02 likelihood calls.

objective.selection: Evaluate endpoint derivative signs; select the lower endpoint if derivative there is nonpositive, upper endpoint if derivative there is nonnegative, otherwise solve the unique derivative root by a bracketed scalar method. Train-selected b is frozen before accessing test objectives.
objective.counts: A single mathematical fit per case. Pilot case results may be reused by exact input/source/protocol hash, so the complete campaign contains 80 distinct fits.

controls.saved_floor_validation: For every case, evaluate the uninhibited floor at the historical intercept on both train and test. Compare with all three model floor states at order16_train and order32_test in the saved expected files.
controls.implementation_crosscheck: Compare the precomputed score components at historical a and the fitted a with the archived spatial.evaluate formula using the same fixed features; all score components must agree within 1e-9 nats.
synthetic_unit_fixtures: Missing/duplicate case and tampered source rejection
controls.reference_scope: These controls validate the new scalar procedure and its frozen baseline correspondence. They do not certify global optimization of the existing inhibited fits.

per_case_required: case, regime, seed and input/source hashes
bound selection and root bracket, residual, iterations
historical and fitted train/test point sum P, nonnegative exposure E, signed exposure C=-E, mark M, timing, location and joint score
held-out deltaP, deltaE, deltaC=-deltaE, deltaM=0, deltaJoint=deltaP+deltaC+deltaM
all six original train/test floor validation differences
all five original raw/gated procedure scores and unchanged gate identities
each procedure original gain and gain versus new refitted floor
reporting.component_convention: E is the nonnegative compensator/exposure, C=-E is the manuscript signed exposure term. Joint=P+C+M. Deltas always mean refitted floor minus historical floor. Never subtract signed C.
reporting.gates: Preserve the original LI raw, LIplus_immigrant raw/BIC and LIplus_inclusive raw/BIC choices. Do not re-gate using the refitted floor and do not refit the inhibited alternatives.
reporting.aggregate: For each regime and existing procedure, report mean new gain and strict-positive win count alongside the unchanged original result, plus the distribution and mean of floor score changes. Publish all 80 per-case diagnostics, including boundary selections.
reporting.interpretation: A sensitivity to a train-fitted uninhibited background intercept. It can reveal a fixed-background comparator handicap. It is not joint nuisance estimation, parameter recovery, or a prospective validation claim.

execution_admission.implementation_review: Independent source review and small deterministic tests must pass before any actual case is scored or fitted.
execution_admission.pilot: The first fixed seed in each regime, in listed order; stop on any mismatch or failure.
execution_admission.admission_projection: After four pilot cases, retain measured per-case wall times and input workloads W=(Ntrain+Ntest)*Nparents+Nparents*Ncells+Nbackground_centres*Ncells. Use 3*max(t_i/W_i)*sum(W_remaining) plus observed setup time as the remaining-time projection; proceed only inside the unchanged campaign cap and conductor deadline. No change to tolerances or case roster after outcomes.
execution_admission.source_memory_argument: Null precomputation uses O(Nparents*Nevents) temporary pair arrays and O(Nparents*Ncells) normalization, released phase by phase, with no inhibitory space-time grid. Record maximum actual roster sizes and pilot process-tree memory before full admission.
execution_admission.lease: One genuinely reserved numerical task and exclusive numerical lease for compilation/controls/pilot/full; conductor monitors process identity, wall time, process-tree memory and quiescence. The memory number is an admission limit unless an actual external supervisor enforces it; report the implemented enforcement and sampling method rather than claiming a hard OS limit.

completion: Complete only if all 80 unique cases, all historical-floor checks, all scalar solver checks, unchanged gate checks and all required output identities pass; otherwise retain partial outputs with passed=false and no completed aggregate claim.
